source_version.content: I’m testing the combined system against the exact operator basis we already recovered in \(Z_{12}\), rather than just comparing pictures. The key question is whether Kepler’s *measured ranges* supply the dynamic versions of the same \(+1,+3,+4,+7\) transformations that appear in our musical/Dee architecture—and what residuals remain when those physical ratios are forced to close on Fludd’s fixed lattice.
